Kuntaleśvara(Kunteśvara)dautya:
On this ascribed to him, see detailed examination of the question an. different views on it an. the probable identity of the Kings Kuntaleśvara an. Vikramāditya figuring in it, in Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa (1963) by V. Raghavan 1963, p.. 776-784 an. B. C. Law Vol. II. p. 191 ff.
Setubandha:
In Alwar 2471, 2472 an. BORI. 55 of 1873-74, Setubandha is ascribed to K. For a tradition that K. wrote this Pkt. poem for Pravarasena a. the behest of Vikramāditya, see Rāmadāsa's C. on Setubandha, MD. 15786 (Extr. p. 10413); for the view that this might refer to Candragupta II Vikramāditya the Gupta Emperor an. his grandson Vākāṭaka Pravarasena II, [Page066-b] see S. Krishnaswami Ayyangar, ABORI. V. p.. 31-54 an. J. Myth. Soc. XV. p.. 160-2; V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa (1963) p.. 782-3. Bhau Daji accepted K.'s authorship of Setuº.
On the tradition identifying him with Īśvarakṛṣṇa, a. of Sāṁkhyakārikās, see ref.s given above, an. also K., Īśvarakṛṣṇa below.
For a ms. of the S. kārikās mentioning K. a. a., see Mad. Uni. R. K. S. 455 (c).
See also Mysore I. p. 608 an. TD. 5019 for a.lex. Prayuktapadamañjarī a. by Īśvarakṛṣṇa Kālidāsa.
See also NCC. II. p. 274a.
